svg.title: It only looks perfect from one seat
svg.text: 4 It only looks perfect from one seat
A projected illusion has one “sweet spot”. Film from there and it looks like a real object.
Sit on the line that leaves the corner
At 2.5 m: 2.0 m out, 1.4 m below the ceiling.
The projector throws a deliberately bent
un-bends it, so from the seat the sphere
is a perfect circle: measured 99.8% round.
How: the four dots tell us how the three real surfaces look to the projector. From the seat those same faces look like a
perfect isometric hexagon. So each object is drawn in that perfect “seat view”, then every projector pixel works out which
surface it lands on and where, and copies the matching spot. That is called anamorphic projection.
